name: Meals on Wheels San Francisco
description: Meals on Wheels San Francisco delivers nutritious meals, safety checks, and social work services to seniors 60+ in San Francisco and northern San Mateo County, helping them stay independent at home.
fullDescription: Meals on Wheels San Francisco delivers nutritious meals, safety checks, and social work services to seniors 60+ in San Francisco and northern San Mateo County, helping them stay independent at home.
whatTheyOffer:
- One meal a day, 7 days a week (including holidays) in San Francisco; weekdays in northern San Mateo County
- Hot or frozen meal plans based on your needs
- Diabetic, low-sodium, and mechanically softened options
- Safety check with each delivery; drivers can bring meals inside
- Home-delivered groceries with the SF-Marin Food Bank for seniors who can cook
- Nutrition and social work services
howToGetIt: You must be 60 or older and live in San Francisco or northern San Mateo County; being homebound, unable to shop or cook, or having recent health problems also factor in. San Francisco residents apply through the Department of Disability and Aging Services intake line at 415-355-6700 (Monday-Friday, 8 a.m.-5 p.m.). Northern San Mateo County residents call MOWSF intake at 415-920-1111. Note - the waitlist has been closed due to funding; call to check current status.
keywords: Meals on Wheels, San Francisco, home delivered meals, senior meals, homebound, hot meals, frozen meals, special diet, home-delivered groceries, northern San Mateo County
